text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and cautious, and its numbers match the card: 16.1% vs 2.3% expected, risk-adjusted score 7.53, z 2.03, 59% (0.595) low-complexity, 12 records, 1 of 2 below billed, 14% peer rate, and 1 of 6 data-reviewed notes without a lab line. Its weaknesses are a few small mismatches and weak next steps.","problems":["Next steps are generic. They ask for a larger sample of 99214/99215 records and a re-screen. The rationale's better advice, to request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims (R21, Z09, N39.0), is not carried into next_steps.","The claim 'several times the all-provider rate in every complexity band' is imprecise. The examples are loosely paired with their labels.","Of the claim IDs mentioned, C0035141 and C0035151 appear in the text but not in cited_claim_ids.","The example claims shown include one high-complexity claim and two low-complexity ones with no documentation, so they add little beyond the packet."]}
